questions.q: What percentage of Americans sleep less than 7 hours nightly?
questions.why: The book states almost 30% of Americans get less than 7 hours.

questions.q: Which study found early school start times affect sleep?
questions.why: A 1998 Brown University study on high school students was cited.

questions.q: What two factors did a 2014 study link to happier couples?
a: Reading before bed and quiet rooms
questions.why: The study showed couples happier when sleeping together and having body contact.

questions.q: What app is recommended to reduce blue light at night?
questions.why: The text recommends installing f.lux to tint screens red at sunset.

questions.q: According to the book, what happens when partners sleep more than an inch apart?
questions.why: 85% of those sleeping less than an inch apart were happy; happiness decreased as distance increased.
